Personal finance guide

Insurance Planning Guide India

Estimate term insurance, health insurance, and protection needs before focusing on investments.

Insurance protects the plan

Investments build wealth, but insurance protects the household from financial shocks. Term insurance is important when others depend on your income.

Health insurance reduces the chance that medical expenses force debt or premature investment withdrawals.

Cover should match responsibilities

Life cover depends on income, liabilities, dependents, future goals, and existing assets. A generic multiple of salary can be a starting point, but not the final answer.

Loans, children's education, spouse support, and parent responsibilities should be considered.

Avoid mixing insurance and investment blindly

Products that combine insurance and investment should be evaluated carefully for cover amount, return, charges, lock-in, and flexibility.

For many households, separate term insurance and goal-based investing may be clearer and more flexible.

Action checklist

  • - List dependents and liabilities.
  • - Estimate future family expenses.
  • - Check existing employer and personal cover.
  • - Keep policy nominees updated.
  • - Review cover after marriage, child, loan, or income changes.
